name: claude-code-usage-meter
description: Shows Claude Code plan-limit percentages (5-hour and 7-day) and a burn-rate projection in the VS Code status bar.

claudeUsage.pollSeconds.description: How often to re-fetch the real plan-limit percentages from GET /api/oauth/usage using your Claude Code OAuth token. The result is shared between VS Code windows, so this is the total request rate, not per window.

claudeUsage.windowDays.description: Rolling window in days for the 'week' figure. Rows older than 8 days are pruned from the cache, so values above 8 are not retained.

claudeUsage.weekTokenBudget.description: Token budget for the weekly window. When > 0 the status bar shows a percent bar. Run 'Claude Usage: Calibrate Budget From /usage' to derive it instead of guessing.

claudeUsage.sessionTokenBudget.description: Token budget for the rolling session window. When > 0 the status bar shows a percent bar.

claudeUsage.sessionWindowHours.description: Length of the rolling 'session' window in hours. Anthropic's session limit resets on a 5-hour rolling window, so the session figure spans every session in the last N hours, not just this conversation.

claudeUsage.showBars.description: Draw a block gauge next to each percentage in the status bar.

claudeUsage.barWidth.description: Number of cells in the status bar gauges.

claudeUsage.alignment.description: Status bar side. Reload the window after changing.
